text:
anna: Heads up — multiple GPU nodes in us-east-1b are showing ALB healthcheck failures, pods stuck NotReady, started ~11:05.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-847 — pinging #eng-infra.
matt: Seeing the same. ALB returning 503s on /healthz.
lia: Any recent infra changes (NACLs/SGs) in that subnet?
anna: I checked SGs — ALB allowed on 8080. SG looks fine. Tried curl from node -> health IP and it times out.
diego: Can you paste the curl + tcpdump output?
anna: From node-02: `curl -v 100.64.12.45:8080` -> Connection timed out. tcpdump shows SYN leaves node, no SYN/ACK back.
matt: Ran `sudo conntrack -L | grep 100.64.12.45` and there are half-open entries. Seems packets are being dropped on the return.
lia: Looked at NACL for subnet-xyz — there's a DENY rule for port range 32768-61000 we added months ago to "lock down high ports". That would block ephemeral egress responses. Reminder: NACLs are stateless so you must allow the ephemeral ranges.
diego: That matches symptoms — SG allows, but NACL denies the ephemeral return ports so ALB healthchecks can't complete.
anna: Quick mitigation: add explicit ALLOW for ephemeral port range outbound (32768-65535) for 0.0.0.0/0 on the subnet NACL and remove the deny rule. I'll run a network-acl replace.
matt: Also recommend clearing conntrack on impacted nodes after the NACL change: `sudo conntrack -F` or restart kube-proxy so existing dropped flows don't keep failing.
lia: I'll file a guardrail to prevent this deny rule being reintroduced (policy + terraform lint).
deploy-bot: Running: `aws ec2 replace-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0abc123 --egress --rule-number 100 --protocol tcp --port-range From=32768,To=65535 --rule-action allow`
anna: Change applied at 11:08. Waiting for propagation.
matt: Healthchecks started to succeed ~30s after change. Rolling restart node-02 to clear conntrack. Pods came back Ready.
diego: Recommend CloudTrail alert that notifies on NACL deny/replace operations targeting ephemeral ports + a dashboard for ALB healthcheck failure spikes.
lia: Filed RFC + PR: add NACL change alerting + required owner tag + terraform policy to block wide ephemeral deny. PR#452.
anna: :thumbsup: Will write a short postmortem. Planning to close incident in 30m if stable.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-847 marked resolved by anna. Root cause: misconfigured NACL deny on ephemeral egress ports causing ALB healthcheck failures. Mitigation: allowed ephemeral outbound range and cleared conntrack on nodes.
matt: Assigning postmortem owner to lia.
anna: I'll draft the postmortem and add the commands we ran.
